GarroshGroundbreakerWarbreaker.name: Warbreaker
GarroshGroundbreakerWarbreaker.description: Quest: Stun Heroes with Groundbreaker. Reward: After Stunning 5 Heroes, Groundbreaker's Stun deals an additional 165 (+4% per level) damage over 3 seconds to Heroes. Reward: After Stunning 15 Heroes, permanently reduce Groundbreaker's cooldown by 2 seconds.

GarroshWreckingBallUnrivaledStrength.name: Unrivaled Strength
GarroshWreckingBallUnrivaledStrength.description: Increase Wrecking Ball's throw range by 25% and its damage by 125%.

GarroshArmorUpBodyCheck.name: Body Check
GarroshArmorUpBodyCheck.description: Activate to deal 111 (+4% per level) damage to a target enemy and Slow them by 35% for 3 seconds. Enemy Heroes hit receive 30% reduced healing for 3 seconds.

GarroshBloodthirstInFortheKill.name: In For the Kill
GarroshBloodthirstInFortheKill.description: Increase Bloodthirst's damage against non-Heroes by 70%. Killing enemies with Bloodthirst resets its cooldown and refunds its Mana cost.

GarroshBloodthirstThirstforBattle.name: Thirst for Battle
GarroshBloodthirstThirstforBattle.description: Basic Attacks against Heroes reduce the cooldown of Bloodthirst by 2 seconds.

GarroshIndomitable.name: Indomitable
GarroshIndomitable.description: Activate to become Unstoppable for 1.5 seconds.

GarroshGroundbreakerIntimidation.name: Intimidation
GarroshGroundbreakerIntimidation.description: Groundbreaker reduces the Attack Speed of Heroes hit by 30% for 4 seconds.

GarroshOppressor.name: Oppressor
GarroshOppressor.description: Basic Attacks and Bloodthirst against Heroes reduce the target's Spell Power by 30% for 2.5 seconds.

GarroshIntotheFrayLoktarOgar.name: Lok-tar ogar!
GarroshIntotheFrayLoktarOgar.description: Increase Into the Fray's Armor by 20. Hitting enemy Heroes with Into the Fray reduces its cooldown by 12 seconds.

GarroshHeroicAbilityWarlordsChallenge.name: Warlord's Challenge
GarroshHeroicAbilityWarlordsChallenge.description: Silence nearby Heroes and force them to attack Garrosh for 2 seconds.

GarroshHeroicAbilityDecimate.name: Decimate
GarroshHeroicAbilityDecimate.description: Deal 50 (+4% per level) damage to nearby enemies and Slow them by 40% for 1.5 seconds. Deals 100% more damage to Heroes, and each Hero hit reduces the cooldown by 1 second. Stores up to 3 charges.

GarroshGroundbreakerDefensiveMeasures.name: Defensive Measures
GarroshGroundbreakerDefensiveMeasures.description: If Groundbreaker Stuns a Hero, Garrosh gains a 350 (+4% per level) Shield for 6 seconds.

GarroshBloodthirstBloodcraze.name: Bloodcraze
GarroshBloodthirstBloodcraze.description: When hitting a Hero, Bloodthirst heals for an additional 15% of Garrosh's maximum Health over 3 seconds.

GarroshArmorUpDoubleUp.name: Double Up
GarroshArmorUpDoubleUp.description: Armor Up can be activated to increase its Armor bonus by 100% for 3 seconds.

GarroshGroundbreakerMortalCombo.name: Mortal Combo
GarroshGroundbreakerMortalCombo.description: Hitting a Hero with Groundbreaker's Stun and throwing them with Wrecking Ball within 3 seconds reduces Wrecking Ball's cooldown by 10 seconds, regardless of order.

GarroshWreckingBallEarthshaker.name: Earthshaker
GarroshWreckingBallEarthshaker.description: Wrecking Ball Stuns enemies near the impact area for 0.5 seconds.

GarroshArmorUpSeasonedSoldier.name: Seasoned Soldier
GarroshArmorUpSeasonedSoldier.description: Gain 5% maximum Health, increase Groundbreaker's Slow duration by 1 second, and Bloodthirst gains an additional charge.

GarroshWarlordsChallengeDeathWish.name: Death Wish
GarroshWarlordsChallengeDeathWish.description: Increase the duration of Warlord's Challenge by 0.5 seconds. If an enemy Hero is killed while Taunted by Warlord's Challenge, its cooldown is reduced by 45 seconds.

GarroshDecimateDeadlyCalm.name: Deadly Calm
GarroshDecimateDeadlyCalm.description: Heroes hit by Decimate deal 40% less damage for 3 seconds.

GarroshWreckingBallTitanicMight.name: Titanic Might
GarroshWreckingBallTitanicMight.description: Wrecking Ball now throws the 2 closest enemies.

GarroshArmorUpInnerRage.name: Inner Rage
GarroshArmorUpInnerRage.description: Body Check gains an additional charge and its healing reduction is increased by an additional 45%.
